about: Y Combinator public site (ycombinator.com): search the YC startup directory (via YC's Algolia index), look up companies, their jobs and job postings, Launch YC posts, the jobs board, and YC people.

commands.summary: List the directory's industry and location categories with their URL slugs, plus links to hiring-by-location pages

params.name: industry
params.description: Industry name to get context for, e.g. 'Developer Tools'

params.name: location
params.description: Location slug to get context for, e.g. 'san-francisco-bay-area'

commands.summary: Get a YC company's profile page by slug (title/tagline and summary description with founders, team size, location, hiring)

params.name: slug
params.description: Company slug as it appears in YC company URLs, e.g. airbnb

commands.summary: List the open job postings of a YC company
Get a job posting (title, description, salary range, location, remote type, date posted) from its structured JobPosting data

params.name: jobId
params.description: Job id plus slug as it appears in the job URL, e.g. HmK9Iqk-machine-learning-engineer

commands.summary: Get a Launch YC post: title, tagline, upvote count, author, company link and posting date

params.name: id
params.description: Launch id plus slug from the launch URL, e.g. ObJ-koyal-the-agentic-ai-filmmaking-platform

commands.summary: List featured jobs at YC startups from the Work at a Startup jobs board
List jobs at YC startups for one role (e.g. product-manager, software-engineer)

params.name: role
params.description: Role slug, e.g. product-manager, software-engineer, designer, sales, marketing

commands.summary: List jobs at YC startups for one role in a given location or remote

params.name: location
params.description: 'remote' or a location slug such as san-francisco

commands.summary: List YC people (president, partners, staff) with short bios and profile links
Get a YC person's profile (name, role, bio) by slug

params.name: slug
params.description: Person slug from list-people URLs, e.g. jared-friedman
